page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 36 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for multi-tier applications and distributed systems. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants.

Given its balanced resource profile, the ecs.g9it.16xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high compute density and moderate memory capacity without the overhead of specialized hardware. It is well-suited for enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and database hosting where local SSD storage is not a prerequisite.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at 3.2 GHz under the KVM hypervisor, this instance maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 36 Gbps, though it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Without local storage, all storage operations are directed to network-attached block storage, making baseline network performance critical. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures stable, non-shared performance for multi-threaded workloads. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for enterprise web serving, application servers, container orchestration, and medium-sized database deployments.
